title: Radioactive
description: A mod that adds various radioactive materials.
body:
![banner 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35f3f28e8f81021dc2b10649f660297a076f3d1f_0.webp)

**Radioactive is a mod that adds radioactive stuff to the game, such as:**

- Radioactive biome, with custom trees and atmosphere
- Radioactivity system, with effects and hazmat armour set
- Nuclear reactors (WIP)
- Radioactive stone, Uranium and more!

⚠️ Keep in mind that this mod is still in development and some features are not final. Expect bugs or glitches. If you find one, please report it on the Discord server.
